note: The script asks for the hook text, her name super, one question line and one key-word line, so 4 graphics and the end card. Atdhe's note on V3: use these graphics from this page.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top third: They were born into AI.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05. Colour born in NFTE orange #FF5C39 if you rebuild it in your edit.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super 00:03–00:05, small, lower left: "Kirsten Theuns" / "Aflatoun".
mg.use: On at 00:03 for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Aflatoun under it.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: how should we prepare young people for this AI world?

mg.cue: Then question text, top third, as she says it: “how should we prepare young people for this AI world?”
mg.use: On her words, about 00:07, after the hook text is gone. Top third.

mg.title: Key words

text.main: really listen to young people themselves

mg.cue: Key words, top third, as she says them: “really listen to young people themselves”.
mg.use: On her words, about 00:19, over the wide shot. Top third.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: NFTE's white logo from the NFTE brand kit (Mac Studio, state/nfte/brand/logos, 9 Oct 2026), endcards/index.json.
mg.use: Right after her last line at 00:31. Hold it to the end, 1 s fade on the music only.
